topic: GPU dedicated kgsl SMMU read SAFETY study (HOST-VERIFIED, no device read performed)
purpose: Establish, BEFORE any device action (m12247), that a READ of the kgsl SMMU register window is unsafe while gpu_cx is collapsed; encode the Linux v6.12 upstream rule that clocks + power domain must be enabled BEFORE any SMMU register access.

upstream_rule.title: clocks + power domain BEFORE SMMU registers
upstream_rule.order: clk_bulk_prepare_enable(2196) < arm_smmu_device_cfg_probe(2200) < arm_smmu_device_reset(2255); pm_runtime_set_active/enable(2265/2266) and rpm_get resume BEFORE register access; a6xx_gmu creates the IOMMU only AFTER power (1277)

device_measurement_reused.note: REUSED, not re-measured in round 53. CX bit31 (PWR_ON_MASK) clear => gpu_cx collapsed => kgsl SMMU (on that rail) must NOT be read.

gate.honest_boundary: Decision layer only. NO MMIO, NO IOKit, NO firmware, NO kernel caller, NO device run, NO flash. gpu area STAYS host-verified; CONFIG_XNU_NATIVE_ADRENO remains n. A real stage-1 SMMU context is future work AFTER a powered GMU.
